title: Ordered and Unordered Coin Counts
statement:
Count ways to form T using unlimited coins, once counting distinct sequences and once counting distinct multisets.

Input
n T, then n denominations.

Output
Print the ordered count and the unordered count modulo 1000000007. For T=0 both counts are one.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 50. Denominations are distinct integers in [1,100000]. 0 ≤ T ≤ 100000.
